name: QUEST-DMC
full_name: Quantum Enhanced Superfluid Technologies for Dark Matter and Cosmology
summary: QUEST-DMC studies light dark matter using superfluid helium-3 and quantum readout, alongside early-Universe analogue experiments. Its dark-matter programme exploits helium-3's unpaired neutron to probe spin-dependent interactions.
detection_principle: Nuclear recoils generate quasiparticles in superfluid 3He. Mechanical nanowires/resonators and readout such as SQUIDs measure the tiny energy deposits.

key_parameters.value: Emphasis on 0.1–1 GeV/c²; this does not mean all parameter space is already excluded.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
